archive_validation.static_text_scan: UTF-8 text; no NUL/binary, secret-assignment, PEM, or network/install-command pattern detected

installed_digests.tree_digest_definition: sorted manifest of all installed payload and generated configuration directories/files, excluding SOURCE-RECORD.json to avoid self-reference; each file line has type, relative path, SHA-256, byte size

license_and_source_limitations: The archive does not supply an explicit redistribution licence; no redistribution permission is inferred.
The primary book and selected exercise solutions retain their stated copyright/source attribution; the exercise material is marked as draft/secondary validation where applicable.
Installation is project-only reference material and does not create verifier admission, Lean-kernel evidence, Result, Solution, or a solved mathematical problem.
content_policy: All archive payload bytes are preserved byte-for-byte; PROJECT-CONFIG.json and SOURCE-RECORD.json are project-local generated metadata.
